note: Sole (green window face) with the hood on top, seen from BELOW (iso-bottom-right, true isometric, transparent background). The 4 F2 stainless M2.5 x 6 socket head screws are pulled 20 mm straight down (screen: straight down) from their counterbored holes in the window face; insertion direction is +z (up, away from the viewer). arrow_to = pixel of the corner counterbore in the window face. The 4 other counterbores (about 1290,628 / 1481,738 / 808,908 / 996,1017) are the board-stack F5 holes, not F2. The screw nearest the middle (axis x=1345) goes to the hole at the top of the picture (1345,438); its head overlaps the F5 hole at (1290,628) only in projection. Hood sits above the sole (its flange shows blue); the F1 inserts in the hood plinth corners are hidden behind the sole.
